title.narrative: Assistance agricole d’urgence aux ménages vulnérables affectés par le cyclone tropical Gamane dans la région Sava

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to quickly improving the food security of households affected by the cyclone in the districts of Antalaha, Sambava, and Vohémar. XXX and partners provide vulnerable households with agricultural inputs, veterinary treatment of animals, and refresher trainings on Climate-Smart Agriculture, Nutrition-Sensitive Agriculture, Climate-Smart Livestock, and integrated crop disease and pest control. A total of 40,000 people, including 8,800 women, 7,200 men, and 24,000 children, as well as 720 persons with disabilities, directly benefit from these interventions.
